summary: A Georgia lookout list gives an Evans County tower named 'claxton' at an elevation of 152 (feet, if so 46.3 m); no history found.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms list entry: tower named claxton in Evans County, elevation 152 with no unit, registers BLL-64697 and gfc-114
tnlandforms page is a bare Georgia lookout list with no site description

corrections.why: The list writes the name in lower case. Title case matches the list's other tower names and the Clarkesville entry in the same list.

notes_for_editor: Only one list names this tower (tnlandforms GA249). The Forest Lookouts Georgia page does not list it. Two searches for an Evans County or Claxton lookout found nothing relevant: a courthouse clock tower and fire-department records, neither a lookout. The elevation unit is assumed to be feet. No status, access or history found. Confidence low.
